title: Animation Curves: Sampling UnitCurve
jsBridge: `UnitCurve` exposes the timing functions behind SwiftUI animations (`easeIn`, `easeOut`, custom bezier). They're CSS `cubic-bezier()` timing functions, sampled as values you can inspect.

compass.q: CSS `ease-in-out` is `cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1)`. Is SwiftUI's `easeInOut` the same curve?
Timing curves vs spring animations: why does Apple default to springs (`.smooth`, `.snappy`)?
Can a curve's value go below 0 or above 1 (overshoot)? What would that look like?
When would you pick a custom curve over a spring in product UI?
